description: Codewhale and Momentic's Mo through their npm names, installed and not run.
why: Neither agent is run, so each npm package is its only witness and removing it from the catalog turns must_find red; forbid_evidence holds ~/.codewhale absent, so a release that starts writing it on install fails here rather than adding a second witness unseen. deepseek-harness is forbidden because Codewhale started as deepseek-tui and defaults to DeepSeek's models; claude-code and codex-cli because npm globals are their route too.
